results: 1. Orthostatic blood pressure and pulse measurements
4. Complete neurological examination, including mental-status and cognitive assessment
mental status / cognitive screen: progressive disorientation, tangential speech, grandiose hallucinations and euphoric affect
deep tendon reflexes and plantar responses: normal
coordination examination (limb and truncal): hemichorea affecting one side
cognitive and behavioural assessment (MMSE / FAB): progressive disorientation, tangential speech, grandiose hallucinations and euphoric affect
skin examination: a painless, non-pruritic confluent erythematous rash on the left arm one day before the chorea began; it improved with doxycycline and clindamycin but the chorea did not
7. Serum electrolytes, urea, creatinine, calcium, magnesium, and liver enzymes
serum electrolytes, urea and creatinine: normal
serum calcium, magnesium and phosphate: normal
10. Serum vitamin B12 and folate levels
vitamin B12 with methylmalonic acid: normal
12. Noncontrast CT scan of the head
CT head (non-contrast): symmetric frontal-predominant atrophy, no focal lesion
dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Lyme neuroborreliosis due to Borrelia burgdorferi, presenting with chorea and neuropsychiatric encephalopathy

ALTERNATIVE: Anti-NMDA receptor autoimmune encephalitis

ALTERNATIVE: Neuropsychiatric systemic lupus erythematosus with antiphospholipid-associated chorea

ALTERNATIVE: Wilson disease due to ATP7B-related copper accumulation

5. Complete skin and lymph-node examination
6. Complete blood count
7. Serum electrolytes, urea, creatinine, calcium, magnesium, and liver enzymes
8. Thyroid-stimulating hormone and free thyroxine
9. Urinalysis
10. Serum vitamin B12 and folate levels
11. Urine toxicology screen
12. Noncontrast CT scan of the head
13. Electroencephalogram
14. Transthoracic echocardiogram
15. Ambulatory cardiac rhythm monitoring
